summary: @agnotology42 Second lesson of the day, modern microformats have nothing to do with JSON (on front end) and everything to do with HTML. Basically your metadata and your good content are the same. We do not hide one from the other or from our readers.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@agnotology42 Second lesson of the day, modern microformats have nothing to do with JSON (on front end) and everything to do with HTML. Basically your metadata and your good content are the same.

We do not hide one from the other or from our readers.
